subject.title: iOS and Android session groups cannot be renamed, deleted, or created empty

question: Should OpenClaw accept mobile session group management parity through the linked PR, narrow the mobile scope, or leave group management web-only for now?
rationale: The issue is protected by a maintainer label, adds mobile UX and persisted client-side group state, and already has a linked candidate PR; cleanup automation should not decide the product scope by closing it.

options.title: Review linked mobile parity PR
options.body: Proceed with reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101234 as the candidate implementation for this issue.

options.title: Narrow mobile scope
options.body: Ask the PR to reduce scope, such as only rename/delete or only one mobile platform, while keeping this issue as the parity tracker.

options.title: Keep web-only for now
options.body: Reject mobile group management for now and close this issue plus the linked PR with that product decision.

recommendation.title: Review linked mobile parity PR
recommendation.body: Proceed with reviewing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101234 as the candidate implementation for this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the recent merged history for both the mobile baseline and web reference, and opened the linked candidate PR.
